rationale: Both reviews are well-grounded (specific file:line citations, quoted code) and both independently catch the real ARDiffusionModelRunner signature gap and the untested DLO+AllGather fallback. But most ground-truth substance (asukaqaq-s's core complaint about duplicated validation across layers, and hsliuustc0106's repeated push for binding/completing the new metadata contracts) lives in stage_kv/interface.py, which is outside the truncated diff both candidates saw, capping recall for both. Y engages that dominant theme directly and repeatedly — flagging the new DiffusionKV DTOs' missing invariants/frozen-ness with a concrete __post_init__ fix, and calling out two redundant identity-check implementations to collapse into one — which closely mirrors the human reviewer's 'same facts derived repeatedly across layers, use the same canonical validator' comment. X's findings are almost entirely of one shape (untested-but-reachable code paths), rigorously cited but narrower, and never surfaces the duplication/validation-ownership critique that anchors the ground truth. Y's tiered Required/Should-fix/Minor structure with inline suggested code also edges out X on actionability.
